verdict.rationale: Poly's Flashback gives any file or folder a timeline of its full past, viewable down to the second, with one-click rollback of files or whole folders. Its docs say any version, including conflict revisions, can be opened, peeked at, downloaded or restored, and a single change can be undone while keeping later edits. Deleted files go to a reversible Archive, and notes are Markdown files covered by the same file history. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration (the GitHub repo is first-party), and an explicitly documented step-by-step flow for restoring a deleted note from the Archive.
